```sql
WITH RECURSIVE fechas(dia) AS (
    SELECT DATE('2026-03-01')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE(dia, '+1 day')
    FROM fechas
    WHERE dia < DATE('2026-03-31')
)
SELECT 
    f.dia AS fecha,
    CASE 
        WHEN p.total_intentos IS NULL OR p.total_intentos = 0 
            THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(p.aprobados * 1.0 / p.total_intentos, 4)
    END AS tasa_aprobacion
FROM fechas f
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        fecha,
        SUM(CASE WHEN aprobado = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aprobados,
        COUNT(*) AS total_intentos
    FROM pagos
    WHERE medio = 'tarjeta'
      AND fecha BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
    GROUP BY fecha
) p ON p.fecha = f.dia
ORDER BY f.dia;
```
